caveat: Field selectability (selectable/filterable/sortable) is largely customer-independent — it reflects the Google Ads API version's schema, not any one account's data. It can still drift release-to-release (new fields added, old ones deprecated) or vary slightly by account feature access (e.g. beta fields). Treat this fixture as a schema snapshot, not a live guarantee — refresh periodically per _shared/README.md's refresh procedure, and re-verify against the live MCP before trusting a field that looks newly added or removed.
